claude.rationale: This is a Chapter 11 balance-sheet reorganization in which the same Delaware corporation continued (re-chartered) with all estate property vesting in the Reorganized Debtors and the operating business (upstream oil and gas production) unchanged, so the customer-facing product/asset (T4) and the operational processes (T5) both carried forward together within the same entity — no product-vs-process mismatch (gap_45=0). The full pre-existing senior management team (Brace, Haight, Elkins) continued in the same roles under new employment agreements and existing benefit/employment agreements were assumed, so processes (T5) and the organization/people (T6) stayed coherently aligned (gap_56=0). T1 is coded replace because pre-petition equity/interests were cancelled and extinguished and ownership was substantially reallocated to former secured creditors (97.5% Second Lien), installing a new controlling principal while the vehicle, model, product, process, and staff transferred whole.

gemini.rationale: The transaction was a Chapter 11 reorganization where the pre-petition equity was cancelled and new equity was issued to creditors, replacing the controlling intent (T1). The legal vehicle, business model, products, operations, and organization (including the full pre-existing senior management team) all transferred 1-1 to the reorganized entity. There is no evidence of a structural mismatch between products and processes (gap_45 = 0) or between processes and organization (gap_56 = 0).

openai.rationale: The operating business remained unchanged, and all estate property vested in the Reorganized Debtors with authority to continue operating, so the product/assets and the processes supporting them moved together without a documented T4–T5 mismatch [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-16-143491, 8-K EX-99.1; SEC accession 0001104659-16-152625, 8-K Items 3.02, 5.02]. The full pre-existing senior management team continued in the same roles under new employment agreements, while employee-related agreements were assumed, so no process-versus-organization gap was documented at closing despite replacement of a board majority [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-16-152625, 8-K Item 5.02; SEC accession 0001104659-16-143491, 8-K EX-99.1].
